clips.title: The story
paras: At Sun Rock Retreat, Tammra Windfield guides Horde travelers in honoring the land's renewal. The tauren watches over the wilderness and the safety of her kin in the Stonetalon Mountains.

Sun Rock Retreat shelters the Horde among the crags of Stonetalon. Harpies, Venture Company loggers, and predators threaten the settlement. Tammra Windfield watches over the mountain wilderness and the travelers who enter. Her gentle manner carries the resolve needed to keep a home safe in such rugged country.

Tammra honors the Earth Mother by watching nature's steady rhythm of growth and decay. She asks travelers to tend the cycle of rebirth and bring forth new life, working against the harm conflict and exploitation cause in Stonetalon. For Tammra, protecting the land means healing it so life can flourish in scarred mountain soil.

Tammra's concern reaches beyond the wilds to the companions and kin who travel Stonetalon's dangerous trails. When word comes that travelers or family have vanished among the crags, she is among the first to seek reliable aid. Sun Rock Retreat endures through loyalty and mutual protection, as well as harmony with nature.
